author: Legoche
body:
Right, Let me get this straight. I am innocent. I would never use an auto clicker on Avicus. I have evidence to prove the accusations against me.

I know other moderators can see this but, I want them too. I want you all to know that I am not a cheater, and I am prepared to prove it. Prepare for your long rant below.

1.

The staircase.

It has been brought to my attention that this clip uses autoclicker. Believe it or not, Stimulating brought this up with me on Skype.

Video: https://youtu.be/iEqi8GGZajI?t=3m2s

Right. I sped it up. I don't know why. I was showing off. After the breezily starts I fall. That was not a no shift, it was a Ninja staircase.


2.

The breezily.

This clip: https://youtu.be/iEqi8GGZajI?t=3m18s

Look at the scoreboard.

Now look at the scoreboard here: https://youtu.be/iEqi8GGZajI?t=3m13s

Different, eh?

I faked the clip on TGC's old server. I used autoclicker to make that. You can tell because in the breezily clip the terrain is untouched. I did this to show off.

3.

Shaking.


Believe it or not, but I am a shakey person. This clip was suspected by Stimulating.

https://youtu.be/iEqi8GGZajI?t=3m29s  <--- Look at my sword. It pauses. I stop clicking. I also stop to place blocks. When using autoclickers, a lot more critical hit particles come off of the player. Also, the sword's durability would degrade a lot quicker than normal

I think that looks like autoclicker. 100% honest. But it isn't. Ask Budah, Raging, Pizza, Galrandir. Anyone who knows me honestly. They can tell you that I shake alot. Here are some videos, old and new,  on Avicus, UHC and Badlion. (Note that Badlion has decent auto clicker detector).

A PvP montage on Avicus: https://youtu.be/nn80EQFXWLo?t=40s

A 1v1 with Raging on Badlion: https://youtu.be/4hRzZhaC5Jg?t=2m24s

A UHC Highlights Video: https://youtu.be/XykgLltLb-s?t=3m56s (Probably my best evidence)

Or any other video.

4.

The whole scrim video.

Here is the scrim footage:

Part 1: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sl0oq-aJw2o&feature=youtu.be

Part 2:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RWlzxNpBSw0&feature=youtu.be

(may not work due to uploading taking  a long time, will get it out fast)

Turns out I only got my audio. I cuss at a few points, including one where I say 'Straightened is bad' I said this because it was a relief I was finally killing the ping monster <3

5.

The reaction of my team.

I understand that the reaction was dramatic, and I did not tell anyone to do anything. I put a message on our Slack telling us to forget about the incident until it is resolved.

Well that is it. I would like all moderators of all types to post replies on this report if possible, as I can counter argument almost anything.

I hope you higher ups come to a conclusion that I am innocent <3

Oh and I am giving up learning Breezily. Too much commotion. If you want to question anyone Raging is the guy, so question him. Also, even if I did autoclick, do you think I would be STUPID enough to upload the evidence? No.

-Lego
